description: Source code for UsbMidiDescriptorParser class, which parses USB MIDI device descriptors, including device info, interface, endpoint, and MIDI jack descriptors.

classes.name: UsbMidiDescriptorParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing USB MIDI device descriptors, extracting device info, interface, endpoint, and jack details.

classes.name: UsbMidiDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB MIDI device (referenced but not defined in this file).

classes.name: UsbMidiJack
classes.description: Represents a MIDI jack within a USB MIDI device, with fields for jack ID, endpoint address, cable number.

classes.name: DeviceInfo
classes.description: Structure holding device information such as vendor ID, product ID, version, manufacturer and product indices.

methods.name: DecodeBcd
methods.description: Decodes a BCD byte into decimal, returns false if invalid.

methods.name: BcdVersionToString
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit BCD version number to string format.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Main method to parse USB MIDI device descriptors into jacks.

methods.name: ParseDeviceInfo
methods.description: Extracts device info from descriptor data.

methods.name: ParseInternal
methods.description: Internal parsing of descriptors, handling interface, endpoint, and class-specific descriptors.

methods.name: ParseDevice
methods.description: Parses device descriptor to extract vendor, product IDs, and version.

methods.name: ParseInterface
methods.description: Parses interface descriptor, determines if it's a MIDI interface.

methods.name: ParseCSInterface
methods.description: Parses class-specific interface descriptors, especially MIDI in/out jacks.

methods.name: ParseEndpoint
methods.description: Parses endpoint descriptor, records endpoint address.

methods.name: ParseCSEndpoint
methods.description: Parses class-specific endpoint descriptor, associates jacks with endpoints.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets parser state and clears temporary data.
